Players Committee card image of [[Lord Sidious (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Once per game, may take Always Two There Are or a Neimoidian into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If alone (or a [Theed Palace] objective on table) and opponent just initiated battle here, may exclude one character of ability < 6 present. Immune to attrition.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/lordsidious_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/db3e071cf5e4812f3c110dbcb9cfcf50d5194ce8 db3e071] (17 February 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
